name: HUMAN MADE Inc.
summary: HUMAN MADE Inc. sells apparel and lifestyle goods in Japan, including mugs, caps, bags, shoes, t-shirts, hoodies, jackets, shirts, denim and trousers, as well as interior goods and towels. Its brands are HUMAN MADE, Buffer and CURRY UP, sold through e-commerce and retail. It was formerly Otsumo Co., Ltd., took its current name in May 2024, and was incorporated in 2016 in Shinagawa.
